prompt: Create a full-body anime-style character illustration on a clean white background: a cute young woman with long pastel pink hair, straight bangs, soft blue-gray eyes, fair skin, and a cheerful open-mouth smile. She stands facing forward in a relaxed fashion-model pose, one hand lowered and the other slightly extended outward, with long flowing twin-tail-like side sections of hair drifting behind her. Dress her in an ornate white summer swimsuit outfit with delicate pale floral embroidery, ruffled off-shoulder bust detail, a central bow, and dark navy crisscross lacing down the torso with a small diamond-shaped cutout at the waist. Add navy ribbon lacing on both hips, a frilly thigh garter on one leg decorated with a large cream flower and dangling navy ribbons, and lace-up flat sandals with floral ornaments and bead anklets. Her accessories should include exactly 6 visible floral adornment groups: two large cream flower hair clips, one small cluster of blue-and-white flowers near the top of the head, one floral bracelet on each wrist, and one flower on the thigh garter. Include long navy ribbons, pearl-like bead strands, tiny blue flower accents, a delicate choker necklace with a pendant, and soft translucent fabric details. Use a refined Japanese gacha character concept-art style with thin clean linework, subtle watercolor shading, pastel colors, elegant decorative details, and high-resolution crisp rendering. Keep the composition centered with the entire body visible from head to sandals, no text, no props, no background scenery, and no extra characters.
